notes: WhaleChat 3.77.0 — a still screen and a session that stays signed in. The offline connectivity pill no longer deletes and rebuilds itself eight times a second (that loop was the visible shaking); market sparklines and the live trading chart now redraw on a calm 12-second cadence instead of every 2 seconds, and every background repaint pauses while a trader is typing, scrolling or dragging so a ticket is never interrupted; pull-to-refresh is contained so a swipe on a chart cannot reload the app; and a sync that arrives without the signed-in account can no longer sign the user out — the device restores its own record and pushes it back. Brevo keys entered in the admin console are now verified against Brevo before they are saved.
